chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Tawaf during the Ten (Days of Dhu al-Hijjah) is superior to seventy Tawafs during the Hajj.

key_terms.طَوَاف: Tawaf, the ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba

ai.seo_question: What is the merit of Tawaf during the first ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah compared to Tawaf during Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from *Al-Kafi* underscores the unique sanctity of the first ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah, often referred to as the 'Days of Hajj,' where acts of worship are multiplied in reward. The comparison to seventy Tawafs during the Hajj season highlights that while Hajj is obligatory, voluntary devotion during these specific days carries exceptional merit, a view supported by scholars like Al-Shaykh al-Mufid who emphasize the distinct spiritual atmosphere of this period. This teaching encourages believers to maximize their worship immediately following Eid al-Adha, recognizing these days as a time of divine acceptance.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Tawaaf during the tenth (of Zil Hijja) is superior than seventy Tawaafs during the Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 17. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn abu ‘Umayr from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Performing a Tawaf on tenth of Dhu al-Hajjah is more virtuous than seventy Tawaf during al-Hajj.’”
